title: California Condors Rebounded To 500 After Near-Extinction
hook: California condors rebounded to 500 after nearly disappearing.
closing: The rescue worked, but lead poisoning means protection cannot stop now.
question: Have you seen a condor?

segments.say: California condors fell to 27 birds, leaving one disaster capable of erasing the species.
California condors rebounded to 500, proving captive breeding reversed a collapse once considered nearly final.
Lead poisoning causes 50% of known condor deaths, keeping the recovery dependent on preventable protection.
